column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 Baal city, post-mansion residents and shops
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Aaaagh! I'm starving! Gimme something to eat!!
This city is a great place... Above all, the food is delicious!!
Lord $$バアル$$ rules this city. He's such a kind gentleman—he's even invited me to dinner before.
Armor!? Never heard of it...
I know truffles, but they aren't food, are they?!
What? A woman with black $$羽$$? Look around—there are plenty of them!
I hear something happened at Lord $$バアル$$'s mansion.
Just a little while ago, they took a whole lot of $$奴隷$$s into the mansion.
What's this, a customer!? That's rare—coming all the way on foot.
But sorry, we're out of ingredients right now...
So get outta here already!
...That's what I'd like to say.
You think just because you talk to a dog, it'll say 'woof'?
Do you always talk to dogs?
Woof.
Sorry, sir!
Everyone who works here has been called to Lord $$バアル$$'s mansion, so there's no one here...
I've been told to go over there later too,
Please come again!!
Welcome!
This shop stocks only food brought in from other towns—goods selected for their shelf life!
We care more about how long our goods last than how they taste!!
Make lots of money, then eat Lord $$バアル$$-brand delicious food!
Now then, what'll you buy!?
Want to buy more?
Yes
No
